## 1. Project Overview

**Project Description:**  
Web Components widget library for visualizing Gas Town monitoring data from gt-monitor API. Provides drop-in, framework-agnostic widgets for building real-time monitoring dashboards.

**Project Objectives:**  
- ✅ Create framework-agnostic Web Components (works with any frontend)
- ✅ Connect to live gt-monitor API for real-time data
- ✅ Support dark theme with customizable CSS properties
- ✅ Auto-refresh data on configurable intervals
- ✅ Bundle as single JS file for easy deployment

**Current Phase:** 🟢 **BETA** - Core widgets functional

## Usage

### Quick Start

```html
<script type="module" src="gt-monitor-ui.js"></script>

<gt-system-vitals endpoint="http://localhost:9090/v1"></gt-system-vitals>
<gt-bead-list endpoint="http://localhost:9090/v1"></gt-bead-list>
```

### Build

```bash
npm install
npm run build
# Output: dist/gt-monitor-ui.js
```
